Vik: RCA published for the snapshot-restore weight-corruption incident — link: <https://redwood.internal/rca/1771000000-snapshot-restore-corruption|rca/snapshot-restore-corruption> :link:
Hannah: thanks. quick TL;DR for execs? need a 1-liner and customer impact bullets.
Vik: TL;DR: an intermittent checksum mismatch during model snapshot restore caused corrupted weight shards to be loaded on a small fraction of Dedicated hosts, producing nonsensical completions for ~0.2% of requests in affected regions between 2026-05-02 01:12–01:57 UTC. No data exfiltration.
Omar: added sample diffs and checksum timelines to the doc (section 2). shows restore retries followed by degraded output signatures.
Priya: which customers saw this? any SLA exposure?
Katie: CS flagged two Dedicated customers with noisy outputs. both accepted rollback + monitoring; no SLA breach found. drafting comms.
Vik: root cause: a race in the snapshot verifier where parallel restores reused a transient buffer before checksum verification completed. corrupt buffers were still written into the model cache. Secondary: our canary didn't exercise multi-shard parallel restores.
Jenna: action items (owner / due):
- make checksum verification atomic before cache write (owner: Omar) — due 2026-05-04
- add canary test for parallel multi-shard restore paths (owner: Priya) — due 2026-05-09
- add post-restore output sanity checks comparing logits to float baseline (owner: Hannah) — due 2026-05-07
- customer comms + credits guideline (owner: Katie) — due 2026-05-03
- update runbook for manual flush and re-restore steps (owner: Vik) — due 2026-05-02
Omar: PR ready that gates cache write until checksum success; integration tests running in staging. linking in doc.
Priya: I'll add the multi-shard restore canary into the nightly canary suite and fail deploy if checksum mismatches occur.
Hannah: I'll wire a lightweight post-restore sanity check comparing top-10 token logits to a reference and alert on divergence >5%.
Katie: posted draft customer note to #customer-success for review; recommending rollback + re-restore offer and small goodwill credit.
ops-bot: RCA PDF uploaded to Drive and incident tracker — <https://drive.redwood/RCAs/1771000000-snapshot-restore-corruption.pdf>
Vik: follow-up checkpoint scheduled: 2026-05-06 15:30 UTC (30m) — invite sent. agenda: PR/CI status, canary metrics, customer outreach updates.
Jenna: please include the one-liner in tomorrow's all-hands: "Small fraction of Dedicated hosts served corrupted model shards during snapshot restore due to a verification race; fixes and customer outreach in progress." I'll slot it in.
Vik: thanks all — ping me if anything missing in the doc. closing thread after checkpoint.
